title_or_hook: Forget tiny portions, we do MEGA plates 🍗
post: Mate, forget splitting a tiny Sunday roast. In Xinjiang, we do 'da pan ji' (big-plate chicken). It’s literally a massive wok of spicy, cumin-loaded chicken and hand-pulled noodles meant for the whole table to dig into. It’s giving massive communal feast energy. You’re tearing naan bread and fighting for the last potato. Proper chaotic, proper cozy. Tag the mates you’d trust to share a mega plate with! 🍗🌶️🥢
